description: This file defines the KmsClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing an interface to interact with the AWS Key Management Service, including method signatures for various KMS operations.

classes.name: KmsClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with AWS KMS, extending the generic AwsClient class.

methods.name: cancelKeyDeletion
methods.description: Method to cancel deletion of a customer master key (CMK).

methods.name: cancelKeyDeletionAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to cancel deletion of a CMK.

methods.name: connectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Connects to a custom key store.

methods.name: connectCustomKeyStoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to connect to a custom key store.

methods.name: createAlias
methods.description: Creates a new alias for a CMK.

methods.name: createAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to create a new alias.

methods.name: createCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Creates a new custom key store.

methods.name: createCustomKeyStoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to create a custom key store.

methods.name: createGrant
methods.description: Grants permission to perform operations on a CMK.

methods.name: createGrantAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to create a grant.

methods.name: createKeyAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to create a key.

methods.name: deleteAliasAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous version to delete an alias.

methods.name: deleteCustomKeyStoreAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous delete of a custom key store.

methods.name: deleteImportedKeyMaterialAsync
methods.description: Asynchronous deletion of imported key material.

methods.name: deriveSharedSecret
methods.description: Derives a shared secret using ECDH.

methods.name: deriveSharedSecretAsync
methods.description: Async version to derive shared secret.

methods.name: describeCustomKeyStoresAsync
methods.description: Async description of custom key stores.

methods.name: describeKey
methods.description: Returns information about a specific key.

methods.name: disconnectCustomKeyStore
methods.description: Disconnects from a custom key store.

methods.name: disconnectCustomKeyStoreAsync
methods.description: Async disconnect from custom key store.

methods.name: enableKeyRotation
methods.description: Enables automatic rotation of the key.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key pair without plaintext.

methods.name: generateDataKeyPairWithoutPlaintextAsync
methods.description: Async generate data key pair without plaintext.

methods.name: generateDataKeyWithoutPlaintext
methods.description: Generates a data key without plaintext.

methods.name: generateDataKeyWithoutPlaintextAsync
methods.description: Async generate data key without plaintext.

methods.name: getKeyPolicy
methods.description: Gets the key policy for a CMK.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Retrieves the public key of a CMK.

methods.name: listKeyPolicies
methods.description: Lists policies attached to a key.

methods.name: listResourceTags
methods.description: Lists tags is attached to a resource.

methods.name: listRetirableGrants
methods.description: Lists grants that can be retired.

methods.name: putKeyPolicy
methods.description: Attaches or replaces a key policy.

methods.name: updateKeyDescription
methods.description: Updates the description of a key.

methods.name: updatePrimaryRegion
methods.description: Updates the primary region of a multi-region key.
